cards.example_en: Trained volunteers can escort elderly residents to medical appointments, improving access to essential healthcare services.
cards.example_zh: 受过培训的志愿者可以陪同老年居民就医，从而改善他们获得基本医疗服务的机会。
cards.explain_zh: 动词重音在后；名词英/ˈeskɔːt/，美/ˈeskɔːrt/。

cards.example_en: Driving through this thick fog would be absolute madness.
cards.example_zh: 在这么浓的雾里开车简直是胡来。
cards.explain_zh: 指精神疾病的用法陈旧且可能冒犯，避免用于诊断。

cards.example_en: Driving through this thick fog would be absolute madness.
cards.example_zh: 在这么浓的雾里开车简直是胡来。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I was unaware that my umbrella was still outside.
cards.example_zh: 我没意识到自己的伞还在外面。
cards.explain_zh: 常用be unaware of或be unaware that从句。

cards.example_en: Many consumers remain unaware of the environmental damage caused by the production of cheap clothing.
cards.example_zh: 许多消费者仍不了解廉价服装生产造成的环境破坏。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The thick walls provided a strong defence against attackers.
cards.example_zh: 厚实的城墙为抵御进攻者提供了坚固的屏障。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写 defence；美式拼写 defense。

cards.example_en: The thick walls provided a strong defence against attackers.
cards.example_zh: 厚实的城墙为抵御进攻者提供了坚固的屏障。

cards.example_en: Our multifunction printer can scan documents and make copies.
cards.example_zh: 我们的多功能打印机可以扫描文件和复印。
cards.explain_zh: 作形容词，常放设备名词前；也可用multifunctional。

cards.example_en: I sympathize with you; losing a pet is painful.
cards.example_zh: 我很理解你的感受；失去宠物确实令人难过。
cards.explain_zh: 不直接接宾语：用 sympathize with；英式也拼 sympathise。

cards.example_en: Rain fell steadily as we walked back from the station.
cards.example_zh: 我们从车站走回来时，雨一直不停地下着。
cards.explain_zh: 图表写作常用rise steadily，指平稳上升而非猛增。

cards.example_en: The mechanic used specialised tools to repair my bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 修理工用专用工具修好了我的自行车。
cards.explain_zh: 英式常用specialised，美式常用specialized。

cards.example_en: Hospitals need specialised equipment and trained staff to provide effective treatment for patients with complex conditions.
cards.example_zh: 医院需要专用设备和受过训练的人员，才能为病情复杂的患者提供有效治疗。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We rested beneath a tall pine after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，我们在一棵高大的松树下休息。
cards.explain_zh: pine for表示渴望或思念；pine away指日渐憔悴。

cards.example_en: We had breakfast on the terrace overlooking the garden.
cards.example_zh: 我们在俯瞰花园的露台上吃了早餐。
cards.explain_zh: 露台通常是较大的室外平台，不等同于balcony。

cards.example_en: She pressed the doorbell gently with her forefinger.
cards.example_zh: 她用食指轻轻按了门铃。
cards.explain_zh: 与index finger同义，都是紧挨拇指的食指。

cards.example_en: He waited anxiously outside while the vet examined his cat.
cards.example_zh: 兽医检查他的猫时，他在外面焦急地等候。
cards.explain_zh: 常含担忧色彩；纯粹高兴地期待多用eagerly。

cards.example_en: Many graduates anxiously await job offers as competition for entry-level positions continues to increase.
cards.example_zh: 随着初级岗位的竞争持续加剧，许多毕业生焦急地等待录用通知。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We plan to rebuild the garden wall this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我们打算这周末重建花园围墙。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为 rebuilt。

cards.example_en: I added detergent before starting the washing machine.
cards.example_zh: 我在启动洗衣机之前加入了洗涤剂。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指洗涤剂时通常不可数；指种类时可数。

cards.example_en: My sister is a freelance designer who works from home.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐是一名在家工作的自由设计师。
cards.explain_zh: work freelance中作副词；freelancer是自由职业者。

cards.example_en: Freelance work offers flexibility, but workers may struggle to maintain a stable income without regular contracts.
cards.example_zh: 自由职业提供了灵活性，但没有固定合同，从业者可能难以维持稳定收入。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The textile industry can reduce water pollution by adopting cleaner production methods and treating wastewater effectively.
cards.example_zh: 纺织业可以采用更清洁的生产方式并有效处理废水，从而减少水污染。
cards.explain_zh: 表示各类纺织品时常用复数textiles。

cards.example_en: The textile industry can reduce water pollution by adopting cleaner production methods and treating wastewater effectively.
cards.example_zh: 纺织业可以采用更清洁的生产方式并有效处理废水，从而减少水污染。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The craftsman carved a wooden bird for the display.
cards.example_zh: 那位工匠雕了一只木鸟用于展示。
cards.explain_zh: 复数为craftsmen；性别中性表达可用craftsperson。

cards.example_en: She tapped her foot with impatience as the queue stalled.
cards.example_zh: 队伍停滞不前，她不耐烦地用脚轻敲地面。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；对某人或事不耐烦常接with。

cards.example_en: Growing impatience with unreliable public transport may encourage commuters to use private cars, increasing urban congestion.
cards.example_zh: 人们对不可靠的公共交通日益不耐烦，可能促使通勤者转而使用私家车，加剧城市拥堵。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The voltage increased by one volt during the experiment.
cards.example_zh: 实验期间电压上升了一伏特。
cards.explain_zh: 伏特衡量电压；瓦特 watt 衡量功率。

cards.example_en: We added fertilizer to help the tomato plants grow.
cards.example_zh: 我们施了肥，帮助番茄植株生长。
cards.explain_zh: 英式也拼作fertiliser；泛指肥料时常不可数。

cards.example_en: Excessive use of chemical fertilizer can pollute nearby rivers and damage the ecosystems that depend on them.
cards.example_zh: 过量使用化肥会污染附近河流，破坏依赖这些河流的生态系统。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We eagerly await the arrival of our new puppy.
cards.example_zh: 我们热切地等待着新来的小狗到家。
cards.explain_zh: 较正式，直接接宾语；不要写await for。

cards.example_en: We eagerly await the arrival of our new puppy.
cards.example_zh: 我们热切地等待着新来的小狗到家。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We explored a medieval castle during our weekend trip.
cards.example_zh: 我们在周末旅行中游览了一座中世纪城堡。
cards.explain_zh: 通常指欧洲约公元500至1500年的中世纪。

cards.example_en: We explored a medieval castle during our weekend trip.
cards.example_zh: 我们在周末旅行中游览了一座中世纪城堡。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: With your guidance, I finally planted the seeds correctly.
cards.example_zh: 在你的指导下，我终于把种子种对了。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数名词；说some guidance，不说a guidance。

cards.example_en: Schools should provide career guidance to help students make informed decisions about further education and employment.
cards.example_zh: 学校应提供职业指导，帮助学生在升学和就业方面作出明智的决定。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The young entrepreneur opened a bakery near our station.
cards.example_zh: 那位年轻创业者在我们车站附近开了一家面包店。
cards.explain_zh: 强调创办企业并承担风险，不泛指经理。

cards.example_en: The driver tried to bribe the officer with cash.
cards.example_zh: 那名司机试图用现金贿赂警察。
cards.explain_zh: bribe的宾语是受贿者；bribery指行贿受贿行为。

cards.example_en: We spent the afternoon learning the basics of bread making.
cards.example_zh: 我们花了一下午学习制作面包的基础方法。
cards.explain_zh: 表“潜质”用复数makings：have the makings of。

cards.example_en: Involving residents in the making of local policy can increase public trust and improve community outcomes.
cards.example_zh: 让居民参与地方政策的制定，可以增强公众信任并改善社区发展成效。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This blunt knife cannot even cut a ripe tomato.
cards.example_zh: 这把钝刀连熟透的番茄都切不开。
cards.explain_zh: 形容言语时指直接甚至冒犯，不一定是褒义。

cards.example_en: I wore a linen shirt on the hot afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 那个炎热的下午，我穿了一件亚麻衬衫。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；bed linen不一定由亚麻制成。

cards.example_en: I wore a linen shirt on the hot afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 那个炎热的下午，我穿了一件亚麻衬衫。

cards.example_en: Use this pastry cutter to make round biscuits.
cards.example_zh: 用这个面点切模做圆形饼干。
cards.explain_zh: 常与材料或技术名连用；wire cutters通常用复数。

cards.example_en: A modern laser cutter can reduce material waste and improve precision in furniture production.
cards.example_zh: 现代激光切割机可以减少材料浪费，提高家具生产的精度。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: After a demanding shift, I fell asleep on the bus.
cards.example_zh: 忙完一班累人的工作后，我在公交车上睡着了。
cards.explain_zh: 修饰任务指费力；修饰人指要求高、难满足。

cards.example_en: Physically demanding jobs may require additional safety measures to protect workers from injuries and long-term health problems.
cards.example_zh: 体力要求高的工作可能需要额外的安全措施，以保护劳动者免受伤害和长期健康问题的影响。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Local artisans carve traditional patterns into wooden furniture, preserving cultural skills while creating products for modern homes.
cards.example_zh: 当地工匠在木制家具上雕刻传统图案，既保留文化技艺，也为现代家庭制作产品。
cards.explain_zh: carve强调削刻成形；carve out a career指开创事业。

cards.example_en: Companies that conceal environmental damage from the public risk losing consumer trust when the truth emerges.
cards.example_zh: 企业若向公众隐瞒环境破坏情况，真相曝光时就可能失去消费者的信任。
cards.explain_zh: conceal比hide正式；常用conceal sth from sb。

cards.example_en: Vehicles travelling through flooded streets can splash dirty water onto pedestrians and damage nearby shop displays.
cards.example_zh: 车辆驶过积水街道时，可能把污水溅到行人身上，并损坏附近商店的陈列品。
cards.explain_zh: splash out on是英式口语，指大手笔花钱买某物。

word.example_en: Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse towels and change bed linen less frequently.
word.example_zh: 酒店可以鼓励住客重复使用毛巾并降低床上用品的更换频率，以减少用水量。
